touches.text: Code that is no longer needed is deleted. Git history keeps it if we ever need it back.

Its web panel is the operator's to-do list: email, trouble tickets, open questions (the ones only the operator can answer). The list is live: items appear as they arrive and leave as they're answered or resolved.
Machine: the operator inbox builds the to-do list from live state, storing nothing (the operator_inbox tool, 17.14).
cairn operator inbox (the to-do list); cairn review <id> "<words>".
Owns the inspectors and gates (9.4): everything in the code pipeline that checks. The exception is diagnostic_inspector, which is base's (17.1).
operator_inbox: builds the operator's to-do list from live state, storing nothing (7.3.7). USERS: Operator.

question: the open-question door: a decision only the operator can make, bound to its ticket, answered in the operator's words. WHY: a spec choice is settled by Akien's head, recorded verbatim, never by a paragraph of CC's. USERS: tickets and CodeMother open them; the operator answers (7.4.2).
system_word: case-folding for system words (device names, verbs, statuses). WHY: anything you type is case-insensitive. USERS: everyone that parses a command.
